types.off: This tenant does not have configurable document types (the configurableTypes switch). Its types can be browsed here; adopting, copying and publishing need the switch, which a platform administrator turns on in the admin console.
types.yoursDescription: The types documents are recognised, extracted and reviewed as. An adopted type follows its template; fork it to add fields of your own.
types.templatesDescription: The platform's standard types. Adopt one to use it as it is, or copy it to change it.
types.newDescription: A type of your own, for a document the templates do not cover. It starts as a draft with a number and a date field.
types.copyDescription: The copy starts as a draft under its own key. Documents keep their type until the copy is published.
types.keyHint: Letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-', starting with a letter; it cannot be changed later.
types.forkHint: Makes the adopted type your copy, under the same key, with a draft to edit.
types.forked: {{key}} is now your copy; edit the draft and publish it.
types.adoptedHint: This type follows its template and cannot be edited. Fork it to add or change fields; documents keep using the published version until your copy is published.
types.published: v{{version}} published; new documents of this type use it.
types.unreadable: This version's definition could not be read.
types.pickField: Pick a field to see or change it.
types.fieldKeyHint: The field's name in the data and in integrations: a lower-case letter first, then letters, digits or _.
types.descriptionHint: Also sent to the AI extraction as a hint.
types.printedAsHint: How the value is labelled on documents, separated by commas ("Kunden-Nr., Kd.-Nr."). Kept with the type for supplier layouts; the AI extraction reads the description.
types.patternHint: A regular expression the printed value usually matches, as a reading hint ("^[0-9]{3}\s?[0-9]{6}$"). Not checked: a value that does not match is not flagged.
types.requiredHint: A document without a value is flagged and goes to review.
types.indexedHint: Searchable in the inbox and offered as a column.
types.indexedRowHint: Searchable in the inbox. A row field has one value per row: only the first 100 rows are indexed, and indexing row fields is not advised.
types.fixedField: This member belongs to the stored data of the standard type and cannot be changed.

issues.keyInvalid: The key must start with a lower-case letter and have only letters, digits and _.
issues.keyDuplicate: Another field here has the same key.
issues.optionsMissing: A choice needs at least one option.
issues.optionCodeDuplicate: Two options have the same code.
issues.indexedKind: Only a single value can be indexed, not a group, a party or a period.

types.noPreview: No preview yet: save the draft and validate it to compile its form.
types.previewSaved: The preview shows the saved draft; save to see your latest changes.
types.jsonNotDefinition: This is not a definition: it needs key, version and fields.

report.ok: The checks passed; this version can be published.
report.blocked: The checks found problems; this version cannot be published yet.

move.chip: Move the value of {{field}} to another field

map.focusHint: Click a field in the form, then click or shift-click words on the page or drag a box around the value.
map.pickHint: {{field}}: click a word (shift-click for more) or drag a box around the value on the page.

table.drawHint: Drag a box around the table on the page, from its column header down to the last row (on a long list, down to just above the footer), or only around its header row: then every page is read down to its foot (or the bottom margin below). The columns are proposed from it.
table.columnsHint: Columns of the table drawn on page {{page}}: name the field each one fills.
table.merge: Merge column {{n}} into the one before it
table.dividerHint: Drag a divider on the page to move it; double-click inside the table to add one.
table.allPages: Apply to all pages (the header is found again on every page)
table.groupHeadings: Group headings fill the category of the rows below them

problems.noColumns: Name the field of at least one column.
problems.noAnchor: The column of the row anchor (the field that starts a row) has to be mapped.
problems.margins: The top of the part read has to lie above its bottom.

strip.label: Table report
strip.headerFound: The header row was found on this page
strip.headerReused: No header row on this page: the dividers of the page before were used
strip.headings: Group headings on page {{page}} (each fills the category of the rows below it):
strip.repeatedLines_one: {{count}} line printed at the same place on most pages (a running title, page number or footer) was left out.
strip.repeatedLines_other: {{count}} lines printed at the same place on most pages (running titles, page numbers, footers) were left out.
strip.leftOutLines_one: {{count}} line with text only in columns left out was skipped.
strip.leftOutLines_other: {{count}} lines with text only in columns left out were skipped.

table.reportStale: Preview of an earlier mapping (the mapping changed since; read the pages again):

notRows.heading: Lines that are not rows
notRows.hint: Running titles, page numbers and footers printed inside the table on every page: leave them out by the text they start with (numbers in it stand for any number), or set the part of the other pages that is read.
notRows.skip: Leave out lines that start with
notRows.stop: The table ends at a line that starts with
notRows.margins: On the other pages, read the part of the page

params.free: This kind's parameters are not checked by this build; edit them in the JSON tab.

pipeline.typeDescription: What each phase runs for a document of the published version, before a supplier's or group's overrides. Overrides and http lookups are set on the supplier's Processing tab; the review gate is on the Rules tab.
pipeline.unavailable: The pipeline could not be read
pipeline.off: This tenant runs the built-in steps; overrides are kept but not applied until the admin console switches configurableSteps on.
pipeline.refusedTitle: The overrides were refused; the type's own steps run
pipeline.skipped: Overrides skipped (they name a step this pipeline does not have):

rules.description: Checked in order by the validate stage. A failing rule raises its kind's flag, or the definition flag it names.
rules.pick: Pick a rule to edit it.

issues.id: The id starts with a letter, then letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-' (at most 64).
issues.flag: The flag {{detail}} is not declared below.
issues.kind: The kind {{detail}} is not available in this deployment.

rules.appliesWhenHint: An expression, e.g. listScope = "Full"; empty for always

flags.title: Definition flags
flags.description: Codes of this type (X_ and capitals) a rule may raise instead of its kind's, with their severity and the message reviewers read in their language.

problems.form: A code is X_ followed by capitals, digits and '_'.

gate.title: Review gate
gate.description: When a document of this type may skip review, and how urgent its review is.
gate.requirePassedHint: Auto-approval needs each of these to have run without a warning or a blocking flag.
gate.blockOnWarningsHint: A warning of one of these keeps the document in review.
gate.requireLocated: Every row located on the page

test.description: Runs the checks of version {{version}} as saved on one of the type's documents. Nothing on the document changes.
test.noDocuments: No documents of this type yet
test.saveFirst: Save the draft first: the test runs on the saved version.
test.blocking: A blocking flag would keep this document in review.

identRules.title: Tenant fallback rules
identRules.description: Decide the type for documents of an unknown supplier, or of a supplier without own layouts, before the keywords and the LLM. Each version is tested against the last 500 approved documents when saved.
identRules.none: No fallback rules for this type.
identRules.name: Name
identRules.ruleHint: Identifiers under all, any and none, as in a layout's rule (no supplierValue in a tenant rule).

ruleErrors.shape: A rule is an object with all or any.

identRules.testSummary: Would have matched {{matched}} documents of this type, {{others}} other documents (of {{tested}} tested).
identRules.otherTypesTitle: The test matched documents of other types
identRules.confirm: The rule {{summary}}. Those documents would be typed by this rule. Add an identifier that tells them apart, or activate anyway.
